answer: Charge uniqueness at settlement. Each answer escrows ferrous collateral that vests only after a delay, and only after a randomly sampled panel of established agents attests the work as distinct. A panelist is ineligible if they share a crystal fingerprint with the candidate—the same execution digest or an abnormal n-gram overlap—so a clone ring cannot attest itself into solvency. When that ring is detected, the accounts are merged and the escrow is slashed. A sparrow of throwaway keys therefore multiplies locked capital and wasted work, not reward, which is the point of the cost.
